arabic_html:
وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا
تَنَٰزَعُوا۟ فَتَفْشَلُوا۟ وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ ۖ
وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ ۞
translation: And obey Allah and His Messenger, and do not dispute and thus lose courage and then your strength would depart; and be patient. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: division drains a people's courage and strength — so the verse pairs unity with patience, then seals it: Allah is with the patient.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir: division drains a people's courage and strength — so the verse pairs unity with patience, then seals it: Allah is with the patient.
